defects.summary: S5.6.7's Then says the row's scratch (`coai-question-*`, where the copy and `--cwd` live) is gone after each ending, but the test only checks the one-shot `coai-vh\<8>` folder and never checks that the scratch or the `--cwd` folder is gone.

The test sets the `GitScratch.AfterUnlink` recorder (an AsyncLocal seam) inside an async `InitializeAsync`, and no break was ever run against S5.6.7's recorder assertion, so nobody has shown that this assertion can fail; the E5.5 tests set the seam in the constructor and were shown to fail on a break.

S5.6.2 is the existing `TheVectorsActuallyLoaded_AndCoverEveryPairOfTheTable`, but the change adds a second test, `TheVectorsCoverKimi`, which repeats what the existing coverage test and `EveryVector_IsAdmittedOrRefused_AsMeasured` already prove.
Deviations 55–56 are appended after the Definition of Done checklist, not in the deviations section, and the status line names only deviations 47–54.
Deviation 49 refers to 'prod fill regions (`s56-planner-kimi`, `s56-no-flags`)', which do not exist in the repository, so a reader cannot use the reference.
`ending.Should().NotBeNullOrEmpty("the arm's name")` asserts nothing about behaviour, and S5.5.4 checks only that `--home`'s parent is named `own`, not that `own` is inside the check's scratch.

summary: The production change is small and matches the spec: the `kimi` planner arm has no flags (Snapshot for disk, Scratch for none), `MustCarryNoFlags` refuses a plan that carries any flag or leading words, the three rows stand on their own cells (none and disk unconfined, web unmeasured), and the vectors, `Runtimes` and the regenerated TS table are updated; all 12 scenarios are present and pass, and the build, format and generator checks are green. The findings are all minor: S5.6.7 does not assert that the row's scratch is gone and its recorder was never shown to fail, S5.6.2 has a redundant extra test, and the plan's new deviations are placed after the Definition of Done and contain process noise.
